markets.question: Who will win Kenya's 2027 presidential election?
markets.resolution_criteria: Select the individual who is finally and lawfully declared elected President of Kenya from the 2027 general election, taking account of any legally required repeat presidential vote. A listed name wins only when that individual is the winner; choose 'Other' for any unlisted person. Use the IEBC presidential declaration and any binding Supreme Court decision that supersedes it. If the election has been annulled and no legally effective replacement result yet exists, keep settlement pending instead of using an annulled result.
markets.resolution_source: IEBC returning officers / final gazetted results; binding election court orders

markets.question: Will William Ruto win the 2027 presidential election?
markets.resolution_criteria: Answer YES only if William Ruto is the legally elected President resulting from Kenya's 2027 presidential election; otherwise answer NO once another candidate's win is legally effective. Determine the result from the IEBC presidential declaration, including a fresh election if required by law, and any binding Supreme Court orders. A poll lead, party endorsement or provisional tally does not count. If a court sets aside the result and the lawful final outcome is not yet known, settlement remains pending.

Answer NO if Ruto wins, another candidate wins or no single joint United Opposition candidate is formally documented. markets.question: Will the 2027 presidential election go to a second round?
markets.resolution_criteria: Answer YES if IEBC formally determines that a second (fresh) presidential election is required under Article 138(5) because no candidate satisfied the constitutional first-round winning requirements. Answer NO if the presidential election ends without such a constitutionally required second round. Evidence is an official IEBC decision/notice and final presidential results, read together with Article 138. Do not confuse a court-ordered repetition of the entire election after annulment with an Article 138 runoff; a legal challenge alone is not a second round.

markets.question: How many presidential candidates will appear on the 2027 ballot?
markets.resolution_criteria: Count the distinct presidential candidates on IEBC's final official list of validly nominated persons who actually appear on the 10 August 2027 presidential ballot. Match the count to 2, 3, 4, 5, or '6 or more'; do not count running mates, disqualified nominees, withdrawn names removed from the ballot, or political parties. Consult IEBC gazette/nomination notices and the final ballot record. If the polling date changes by an official order, apply the same test to the lawful general-election presidential ballot.

markets.question: Will the 2027 presidential election be challenged at the Supreme Court?
markets.resolution_criteria: Answer YES only if a petition formally challenging the validity of the 2027 presidential election is filed in the Supreme Court of Kenya within the time permitted by Article 140(1), measured from IEBC's declaration of the President-elect. Answer NO if no such petition is officially filed within that statutory period. Use the Supreme Court registry/case record, not media predictions, threatened lawsuits, lower-court cases, or an election petition that was merely drafted. Filing counts even if the petition is later dismissed.
markets.resolution_source: Supreme Court of Kenya case registry (Article 140)

markets.question: Which political party will win the most National Assembly seats in 2027?
markets.resolution_criteria: Count every elected member of the 2027 National Assembly by the party shown on their successful election ticket, covering 290 constituency MPs and 47 elected county Woman Representatives (337 elected seats total). Exclude 12 party-list nominees and the Speaker. The party with the highest combined count wins; 'Other' covers any unlisted party. Use IEBC final seat declarations and legally effective judgments. If two parties finish tied for first with no tie option offered, do not arbitrarily award a winner; flag for an agreed tie-settlement procedure.
markets.resolution_source: IEBC returning officers / final gazetted results; binding election court orders

markets.question: Will the United Opposition secure a majority in the National Assembly in 2027?

Allocate elected seats from IEBC declarations and nominated seats from official gazettes. Count a member only with the coalition to which their party formally belongs at that sitting; do not assume all anti-government MPs are alliance members. A Speaker is not an additional voting member.
